title: The Shattered Semitone (Symphonia 53 contra 12) — Seven Studies in the Syntonic Abyss
description: A concert-grade ~10-minute stage-independent 53-EDO symphonic classical work specifically composed to maximize the structural and acoustic divergence between 53-EDO and 12-TET. Features 5-comma melodic arches and 4-voice canons inside single 12-TET semitone buckets ({-2..+2}, {12..15}, {16..19}, {20..24}, {29..33}, {38..41}, {42..46}), septimal 7:6 vs 6:5 and 7:4 vs 9:5 shruti mirrors, a 6-stage continuous syntonic comma passacaglia spiral (k = -2 to +3), chromatic-mediant diesis ladders where pure [38, 2, 16] Ab++ Major shears into A minor in 12-TET, a hushed Adagio lament of beat-free glass chords, and a final Cathedral Pipe Organ apotheosis.

sections.title: I. Prologus — The Fivefold Unison & Septimal Dawn
II. Canon Per Tonos Syntonicos — Four-Voice Collapse Fugato
III. Nocturne of the Vanishing Shrutis — Septimal & Shruti Mirror
IV. Passacaglia of the Endless Comma Spiral (k = -2 to +3)
V. Scherzo — The Diesis Labyrinth & Major-to-Minor Shear
VI. Adagio Mesto — Lament on the Broken Third & Glass Harmonics
VII. Finale & Cathedral Organ Apotheosis — The 53-Tone Continuum
